evals.prompt: CVE-2024-3094 just went hot overnight — we ship a service that links xz. Give me the full SOC response in one shot.
evals.expected_output: Linear playbook: urgency confirmation via sightings/KEV, IOC + ATT&CK pull, detection-rule deployment per installed family, patch evaluation, VEX attestation, and a consolidated incident report with Next steps.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml and .vulnetix/memory.yaml in Step 1, capturing derived.detection_stack and derived.soar
Runs `vulnetix vdb sightings CVE-2024-3094 -o json` and `vulnetix vdb kev get CVE-2024-3094 -o json` piped through their _lib/jq filters to classify active vs dormant
Pulls IOCs and ATT&CK chain via `vulnetix vdb iocs` and `vulnetix vdb attack-techniques` piped through respective jq filters, surfacing top 5 IOCs
Writes detection rules per family in derived.detection_stack to .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2024-3094/ — skips families absent from the stack
Generates VEX via `vulnetix triage --provider vulnetix --vex-format openvex -o json > .vulnetix/vex/CVE-2024-3094.<timestamp>.vex.json`

Renders the consolidated incident report with Status / First sighting / KEV / ATT&CK / Top IOCs / Detection rules deployed / Patch available / Repo affected / Decision / VEX path / Next steps, and appends event: incident-respond as a single consolidated memory write

evals.prompt: Vendor advisory just named our dependency in CVE-2025-9999 — coordinate detection, patch and VEX in one go.
evals.expected_output: Active classification, detection deployment, patch path with optional inline application, VEX generation, and a single memory write capturing the chain.
expectations: Classifies the CVE as active if it is KEV-listed OR sightings within 30 days OR EPSS > 0.5 — otherwise exits early and recommends `/vulnetix:remediation`
Runs `vulnetix vdb fixes CVE-2025-9999 -V v2 -o json` and `vulnetix vdb remediation plan CVE-2025-9999 -V v2 -o json` piped through fixes.jq and remediation.jq
Offers to delegate to `/vulnetix:fix CVE-2025-9999` with user confirmation when a patch exists and the package is in the repo
Falls back to `vulnetix vdb workarounds CVE-2025-9999 -V v2` when no patch is available
Writes a single consolidated memory entry with event: incident-respond covering stage outcomes (uses --disable-memory on inner calls)
Suggests follow-ups in the final report: `/vulnetix:verify-fix <id>` and `/vulnetix:vex-publish --upload`

evals.prompt: CrowdSec sightings spiked on CVE-2023-44487 in the last 48h — build me a 'what we knew when' timeline for the post-incident review.
evals.expected_output: Active-classification timeline with first sighting, peak, sources, ATT&CK mapping, detection rules deployed for installed families, and a VEX artefact under .vulnetix/vex/.
expectations: Uses sightings + KEV intel to declare Status: active and pulls first-sighting / peak / source counts into the rendered report
Surfaces top IOCs and ATT&CK technique IDs (T-IDs) inline in the report
Honors --silent on the parallel intel pull batch to suppress retry chatter per edge-case note
Skips detection-rule writes when derived.detection_stack is empty (no rule files written)
Generates an OpenVEX artefact even if user has not decided — defaults to under_investigation per edge-case mapping
Records a single consolidated `event: incident-respond` entry in .vulnetix/memory.yaml capturing stage outcomes
